Start with the business need: visibility may point to IoT; repeated handoffs to automation; a specific user workflow to an application; and a business-platform requirement to Zoho consultation. The services can be combined where needed.

Yes. A connected project may include devices, software, design, integrations, and automation. Scope, dependencies, and ownership are defined together rather than treating each component independently.

An assessment can review the current workflow, code or platform configuration, integrations, and operating constraints. Configuration or focused improvement may be a suitable option.

A useful starting discussion clarifies the problem, relevant users, existing systems, assumptions, and the next information needed. Any paid discovery or delivery scope is agreed separately.
